set.body:
Objective
Determine whether canonical Transport carries recognition-related information conditionally on saliency, behavioral correctness, and probe type in the full Wynn retrieval cohort, and define a scientifically honest parameter-sensitivity follow-up.

Status boundary
This is post-court exploratory work. It cannot revise the frozen GW-18.10 primary result or create a confirmatory claim. All outcome-informed model choices and parameter comparisons must be labeled exploratory.

Acceptance criteria
- Use the frozen out-of-fold Transport scores and unchanged 1,295-trial support.
- Quantify gaze information by saliency x correctness x probe type with crossed participant/item uncertainty and explicit cell support.
- Compare additive and heterogeneous Transport terms by held-out behavioral log loss using the existing crossed folds.
- Report all modeled contrasts and stability diagnostics, not a selected favorable subgroup.
- Specify any parameter grid before rescoring; score all cells and do not select a winner on these behavioral outcomes.
- Keep private Wynn data and trial-linked predictions Git-ignored.
- Preserve the canonical unversioned public Transport API and frozen court artifacts.
set.title: GW-19 Explore Transport recognition heterogeneity and parameter sensitivity
